reused.name: Absent-User-Diagnostic-SM
reused.comment: It is defined for the S6c interface, see clause 5.3.3.20

normalizations: SGSN-Absent-User-Diagnostic SM in table 5.3.3.1/1 is normalized to SGSN-Absent-User-Diagnostic-SM from clause 5.3.3.11.
UE_ MEMORY_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED in clause 5.3.3.19 is normalized to UE_MEMORY_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED.
Flag separators and spacing in the tables are normalized to comma-separated symbols.
Reused MME-Location Information, eNodeB-Id and Extended-eNodeB-Id table spellings use the established hyphenation and ID capitalization.
